title: Client-Side LocalStorage State Persistence Guidelines
keyTechniques: Wrap JSON.parse() and JSON.stringify() inside try-catch blocks to safely handle corrupted data or QuotaExceededError
Provide safe default fallback values if the storage key is missing or invalid
Create dedicated helper utilities (e.g., loadState(), saveState()) to centralize storage key management
Include a namespace prefix in storage keys (e.g., app_tasks_v1) to prevent key collision with other scripts
avoid: Do not store sensitive user credentials, access tokens, or personal identifiable information in unencrypted localStorage
Do not assume localStorage is guaranteed to be available (e.g. inside private browsing or disabled cookies)
